name: commutative_addu
question: How do equivalent indexing and byte-address expressions order the base and scaled-index operands in the PCode addu sequence?

variants.name: array_base_index
variants.intent: Uses ordinary base[index] spelling so the base operand precedes the index in source.

variants.name: array_index_base
variants.intent: Uses the equivalent index[base] spelling to reverse the source order of the subscript operands.

variants.name: pointer_base_index
variants.intent: Uses typed base + index pointer arithmetic with the pointer base written first.

variants.name: pointer_index_base
variants.intent: Uses equivalent typed index + base pointer arithmetic with the index written first.

variants.name: byte_base_offset
variants.intent: Converts the base to bytes and adds an explicitly scaled byte offset with the base written first.

variants.name: byte_offset_base
variants.intent: Uses the same raw byte offset with the scaled index written before the byte base.
